tests.title: parses named, shorthand and constant options with native ranges and refuses everything else with exact messages
negotiates packed double for every input format, keeps counts and declares the two LFO phases as state
refuses mono, multichannel and masked layouts and requires a configured format for empty input
matches a direct C transcription across modes, timings and options, with identical output for 1/7/29/50-sample splits and untouched inputs
converts integer and planar input to packed double and enforces allocation, format, finiteness and cancellation limits
runs against the 946fcce0 reference built with --disable-x86asm
matches native bytes for every non-sine mode, bpm/ms/hz timing, offsets and widths with amount 0 and 1 and level edges
matches native bytes for every non-sine mode and timing with amount 0.6 on linux-x64
matches native bytes in composed chains, WAV output and output time selection, independent of asetnsamples grouping
fails explicitly before output for sine, non-stereo input, native option errors and unimplemented forms

details: 2220 byte comparisons on every platform: 4 modes x 6 timings (bpm 30/137.5, ms 10/777, hz 0.01/100) x 3 offset pairs x 3 widths x 5 raw sources (u8 8000, s16le 44100, s32le 48000, f32le 8000, f64le 44100) for amount 0 and 1, plus 60 power-of-two level_in/level_out edge cases; outputs rotate over raw f64le, raw s16le, s16 framecrc and f64 framecrc; -cpuflags 0
1128 byte comparisons on linux-x64 only: the same 1080-case sweep with amount 0.6, plus 4 chains with amount 0.6 or non-power-of-two levels x 3 sources x 4 outputs

230 byte comparisons on every platform: 8 chains (alone, shorthand, asetnsamples=n=7:p=0 before/after/around, volume=0.5 and apad=pad_len=9 on both sides, two apulsators) x 4 sources (s16le, f32le, u8, WAV) x 7 outputs (4 plain, -ss/-t, -ss, -frames:a 2), 4 whole WAV files (s16 and f64), and asetnsamples n=7/n=8 groupings (native gives identical bytes for both)

28 native exit statuses: sine in 4 forms, mono and 3-channel input (native 0, remixed), 15 out-of-range values (256-ERANGE from os.constants.errno), enable (176, AVERROR_PATCHWELCOME), unknown option (8), positional after named, unknown mode and too many values (256-EINVAL), fractional ms and an expression (native 0)

unsupported: mode=sine (the default; libm sin()), so bare apulsator is refused
option expressions, suffixes, quoting and fractional values for the integer options ms, mode and timing
mono, multichannel and non-default WAV/W64 masks (native remixes implicitly)
FLAC input (flacInput not declared; refused before decoding)
non-finite input samples and NaN output from overflow
automatic sample-rate conversion inside the chain
byte-exact claims off linux-x64 for amount strictly between 0 and 1

notes: Setup durations: Node 24 fetched via npx node@24 (24.22.3; sandbox Node was 22.23.5 and bootstrap requires 24+), ~10 s; bootstrap --only npm,submodule,reference --allow-unpinned-reference 210 s (npm 7.5 s, submodule 6.7 s, reference build ~196 s); baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries+registry tests 69 s, all passing.
The sandbox-built reference sha256 matches the pinned linux-x64 artifact recorded in wave 1 (ac302e4d...), though the tests never pin it.
Capabilities declare allocatesFrames=true and every other flag false as specified; the chain derives reframes=true for the stream step (asserted in the unit test).

Gating deviation (precaution, no measured macOS difference): the spec lists square-mode cases as platform-independent, but with amount in (0,1) the final procL + inL*(1-amount) still adds two inexact products, so every amount=0.6 case (square included) is linux-x64 only. amount 0 and 1 cases of every mode run on both platforms.
Differential file runs in about 45 s on this sandbox with --maxWorkers=1; unit file about 6 s.
volume=0.5 before apulsator negotiates flt for volume and dbl for apulsator, matching native bytes.
No shared edits beyond the registry line were needed.
